description: Frontend data-flow updates for the Goal API proxy. The match identifier is now the Goal API fixture id (goalApiId). Because the backend sets `id = goalApiId` on every normalized football match, the existing `m.id`-based navigation/keys/dedupe keep working; navigation passes the goalApiId. FixturesScreen drops the 2-minute polling (load on mount + pull-to-refresh only). LiveScreen filters to live-only (user requirement: the live page shows only live/ongoing matches, even though /football/live now also returns recently-finished matches). HomeScreen drops a DB-debugging artifact. MatchDetailScreen is verified to work with goalApiId. The frontend must typecheck (`npx tsc --noEmit` = exit 0). Depends on FEAT-001's contract (backend returns `id` = `goalApiId` on every football match row).
steps: Edit android/src/services/api.ts: in the `FootballMatch` interface change `goalApiId?: string | null` to `goalApiId: string` (always present from the proxy). Keep `id: string` (= goalApiId from the backend). Rename the `getMatch` parameter for clarity: `getMatch: (goalApiId: string) => client.get<any>(`/football/matches/${goalApiId}`).then(r => r.data)`. Leave all other football/cricket/health endpoints unchanged.

Edit android/src/screens/FixturesScreen.tsx: delete the `useEffect` that sets a `setInterval(() => { if (selectedDateRef.current === today) loadDate(...) }, 2 * 60_000)` (the 2-minute polling), and delete the `selectedDateRef` `useRef` and the `selectedDateRef.current = date` assignment in `handleDateChange` (they were only used by the polling). Keep the `RefreshControl` (pull-to-refresh) and the `useEffect(() => { loadDate(today); }, [loadDate])` load-on-mount. Keep `fixEarlyLive` in `loadDate` (defensive).

Edit android/src/screens/LiveScreen.tsx: import `cleanLive` from '../utils/featured' (the file already imports `dedupeMatches, fixEarlyLive` — add `cleanLive`). In the `load` function change `setFootball(dedupeMatches(fixEarlyLive(fb)))` to `setFootball(dedupeMatches(cleanLive(fb)))`. In the `useLiveUpdates` `onFootballUpdate` handler change `setFootball(dedupeMatches(fixEarlyLive(matches)))` to `setFootball(dedupeMatches(cleanLive(matches)))`. This guarantees the live page shows only live matches even though /football/live returns live + recently finished. Remove the now-unused `fixEarlyLive` import if no other reference remains in this file.

Edit android/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: delete the DEV-only `useEffect` that logs `[HOME] competitions in by-date data` (the block guarded by `if (!__DEV__ || nearbyFootball.length === 0) return;`). Keep the 30s poll, the WebSocket `useLiveUpdates` (its `onFootballUpdate` already uses `cleanLive`), `buildFeatured`, and `nearbyFootball` (by-date) for results/upcoming.

Edit android/src/screens/MatchDetailScreen.tsx: no logic change is required — navigation already passes `m.id` (= goalApiId after FEAT-001) and the screen calls `footballApi.getMatch(matchId)`. Update ONLY the misleading comment above `LIVE_REFRESH_MS` that says 'Keep it at 0 until the backend caches match details, because every refresh currently makes 4 requests to the sports provider' — the backend now proxies Goal API directly with no quota limit, so the 60s live refresh is safe. Keep `LIVE_REFRESH_MS = 60_000`.
Verify: `cd f:\Score Koto\android && npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: FixturesScreen has no `setInterval` and no `selectedDateRef`; it loads on mount and on pull-to-refresh only.
LiveScreen filters football to live-only via `cleanLive` in both the REST load and the WebSocket handler.
HomeScreen has no DEV-only competition-name logging useEffect.
api.ts `FootballMatch` has `goalApiId: string` (required) and `getMatch` takes a `goalApiId` param.
No screen passes an internal DB uuid to MatchDetail — navigation uses `m.id` which is the goalApiId.
verification: cd f:\Score Koto\android && npx tsc --noEmit  (expect: exit 0)
findings: All 5 steps implemented; frontend typechecks (npx tsc --noEmit = exit 0). Contract note for later steps: FootballMatch.goalApiId is now REQUIRED (string) in android/src/services/api.ts and getMatch takes a goalApiId param — the backend (FEAT-001) MUST return goalApiId on every football match row (id === goalApiId). LiveScreen filters live football via cleanLive in both REST load and WebSocket onFootballUpdate (fixEarlyLive import removed there). FixturesScreen now loads on mount + pull-to-refresh only (2-min setInterval polling and selectedDateRef useRef removed; RefreshControl kept; fixEarlyLive kept defensively in loadDate). HomeScreen DEV-only competition-name debug useEffect removed. MatchDetailScreen unchanged logically; only the stale LIVE_REFRESH_MS comment updated (60s live refresh is safe because the backend proxies Goal API directly with no quota limit).
